name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
one_liner: Salesforce B2C Commerce platform exposing Shopper/Admin APIs (SCAPI, legacy OCAPI) per tenant.
auth_notes: Shopper APIs use Bearer access tokens obtained via SLAS (Shopper Login) with clientId, organizationId, shortCode and siteId; Admin API auth not verified (official docs return HTTP 403).
access_notes: SDK README says SCAPI must be configured for the tenant. Licence cost, sandbox provisioning and credential steps not readable because developer.salesforce.com returns HTTP 403 to the fetcher.

buildability.rationale: Documented SCAPI with official SDKs and SLAS tokens, but per-tenant SCAPI configuration is required and cost/credential path could not be verified from blocked official docs.

needs_human_reason: developer.salesforce.com pages return HTTP 403; verify access cost, Account Manager client setup, sandbox and rate limits in a browser. Official MCP claim rests on the vendor GitHub org repo description.
